retry-backoff:call.title: Retries to Partner scoring API need jittered backoff.
retry-backoff:call.message: Decision service retries in step with every other caller: waves of retries reach Partner scoring API together.
retry-backoff:call.rationale: Retries add load when a dependency is struggling. Bound repeated work and keep it safe to repeat.

fix.label: Use jittered backoff (100 ms ×2, up to 2 s, full jitter)

retry-budget:call.title: No retry budget on the call to Partner scoring API.
retry-budget:call.message: If Partner scoring API slows down, 3 attempts per request multiply its load by 3.
retry-budget:call.rationale: Retries add load when a dependency is struggling. Bound repeated work and keep it safe to repeat.
